name: The Ember forge at the caldera lip

variants.note: Closed or quiet presentation when the approved story stage requires it.
Forge mouth lit, tools in use and smoke only from its drawn flue.

approval.note: W0 design proposal for Claude review; no art, material ID, painter or live placement approval.

story.lore: The caldera forge and the Company’s pressure on it connect Ashe’s region to the wider story. Weapon lines and prices remain proposals in #290.

todo: Purpose: Keep the named forge a unique destination while its walls, steps and work props reuse the castle/forge kit.

Visual brief: A stone furnace anchored into cooled basalt, a visibly open hot mouth and chimney, stacked working levels reached by the Forge Stair; silhouette sits below the crater rather than mimicking a second volcano.
Widths and size: Civic building body 222–407 art px wide, 200–370 high; larger terrace/platform is composed from kit, not included as an oversized prop.
Implement after review: choose authored anchors, exact collision and approved variant art; these cell envelopes are layout proposals, not measured sprite bounds.
No new forging costs, tier unlocks or rewards; scene/gameplay owners attach approved service data.
Lighting: Upper left; material-specific ramps and directional planes; no mirror-only relighting.
Scale proxy: civic constrains the central building body, with terrace, chimney and external cliff composed and reviewed separately.
